name: Shailender Kumar
headline: Senior Vice President, Regional Managing Director – Oracle India, NetSuite - JAPAC
about:
Shailender, more frequently addressed by family and friends as ‘Shaily’, is a committed leader with more than 30 years of experience, building high performing teams and running successful businesses. Currently he leads Oracle’s sales operations in India across technology and applications, while also helping drive business expansion for one of Oracle’s prominent business units – Oracle NetSuite. He is leading the growth mandate for NetSuite in Japan and Asia Pacific which includes Australia, China, HK, India, South East Asia and Taiwan. Shaily has served in leadership positions in BEA Systems, Quest Software, Microsoft India and IBM India before joining Oracle.
 
In his free time, Shaily enjoys spending time with his family. He is avid lover of sports, movies and simply loves South Indian cuisine
 
His philosophy in life:
• To be successful, it’s important to be a risk taker
• Create an environment that does not punish failure
• Speed of innovation is quick – there is no time to learn and adapt. Do it now.
